processing_tool.name: Pillow
processing_tool.alpha_resampling: convert RGBA to premultiplied RGBa, resize with Image.Resampling.LANCZOS, convert back to RGBA

dds_conversion.strict_validation: 128-byte legacy header, BGRA masks, DDSCAPS_TEXTURE, 18x18 RGBA decode, alpha 0-255, 1424 bytes total, decoded pixels equal processed PNG exactly

source.exact_submitted_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Hearts of Iron IV inline custom resource texticon for Event 020 decision and requirement rows, reduced to a transparent 18x18 RGBA canvas
Primary request: Create a distinct Response Capacity symbol for the maximum number of simultaneous plague-response operations the government can support. This is usable operational room, not stored medicine and not a progress meter.
Input images: Image 1 is the installed vanilla HOI4 civilian-factory texticon, used only for restrained painterly resource-icon treatment, compact footprint, and contrast; do not copy its building subject.
Scene/backdrop: No scene. Genuine transparent background.
Subject: A single compact, broad-fronted WWII field-triage tent with exactly two large, plainly separated treatment-bay openings. Put one large warm-ivory medical cross high on the shared canvas roof. The two dark olive-shadowed openings must remain distinct and readable as two service slots at 18x18. Show the whole shelter as one clear silhouette.
Style/medium: Original, softly paintered Hearts of Iron IV resource icon with broad painted color areas, aged khaki canvas, dark olive shadows, muted brown frame, and subtle hand-painted edge highlights. Keep the silhouette bold and the value contrast strong. Use a mild dark edge and small natural shadow, without a sticker outline.
Composition/framing: Nearly square compact object, centered and filling about 80 percent of the canvas with transparent margin. Straight-on front view with very slight three-quarter depth; roof and bay openings occupy most of the visible area. Simplify the structure specifically for 18x18 readability.
Lighting/mood: Practical, muted field-service lighting.
Color palette: Weathered khaki, olive drab, charcoal-olive bay shadows, restrained brown supports, warm ivory cross.
Materials/textures: Canvas and broad wooden or metal supports; show only broad texture that survives downsampling.
Constraints: Request real alpha transparency in the initial image. No opaque background, no tile or frame, no ropes, guy-lines, skinny wire, thin support clutter, cot legs, equipment crates, satchels, vials, bandages, text, numbers, letters, watermark, fake checkerboard, progress bar, gauge, glow, people, blood, gore, or modern objects. The two treatment-bay openings are intentional dark opaque shadows, not transparent holes. Keep the outer tent edges complete and uncropped; do not copy the reference.
